# NoMoreIDE

NoMoreIDE is an AI-native local development workbench for services, activity, Docker, Git and worktrees, GitHub, Vercel, databases, workflows, terminals, and portable agent environments.

Documentation reviewed for NoMoreIDE v0.1.99 in August 2026.

Primary documentation:
- Human docs: https://www.nomoreide.com/docs
- Full AI docs: https://www.nomoreide.com/llms-full.txt
- AI agent guide: https://www.nomoreide.com/docs/ai-guide.md
- GitHub: https://github.com/Rorogogogo/nomoreide
- npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/nomoreide

Install (no Node.js required; a single binary plus its dashboard):
curl -fsSL https://www.nomoreide.com/install.sh | sh
It detects OS and architecture, verifies the download against the release's SHA256SUMS, and installs into ~/.local/bin. Pass --version, --prefix, or --uninstall via `sh -s --`. The npm package remains published for a deprecation window as a compatibility shim.

Recommended setup (MCP plus the bundled nomoreide-debug skill):
nomoreide setup codex
nomoreide setup claude
nomoreide setup gemini

Manual MCP-only setup:
claude mcp add --transport stdio nomoreide -- nomoreide mcp
codex mcp add nomoreide -- nomoreide mcp

Gemini MCP server:
{"mcpServers":{"nomoreide":{"command":"nomoreide","args":["mcp"]}}}

Verify inside the agent with /mcp.
Open the Web UI at http://127.0.0.1:4317/ by default.
